meta.title: Credit/Debit Note Auto-Suggestion on Invoice Mismatch: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Sign in as an AP Executive on the lower-plan tenant
Use Credit/Debit Note Auto-Suggestion when an invoiced item is missing from the PO
Assert that the capability is unavailable on a plan below Growth
Repeat the workflow on a Growth tenant
Assert that the capability is available on Growth
Compare the same user and workflow across different plan tiers
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as an AP Executive on the lower-plan tenant; Use Credit/Debit Note Auto-Suggestion when an invoiced item is missing from the PO; Assert that the capability is unavailable on a plan below Growth; Repeat the workflow on a Growth tenant; Assert that the capability is available on Growth; Compare the same user and workflow across different plan tiers

args.need: sign in as the AP Executive on both a below-Growth tenant and a Growth tenant, run Credit/Debit Note Auto-Suggestion for an invoice item missing from the PO, and report whether the feature is absent or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the AP Executive workflow, invoice mismatch screen, credit/debit-note suggestion capability, or plan-tier comparison.
Provides the required final assertion about the observable session state, but does not establish the requested feature availability.
